title: Prestige can be played only with a card to De-Radiant
notes: R1851000-R1851003: Meditative #53 Prestige is offered, and its play accepted, only while a Radiant card it could De-Radiant exists, where R1103 let either face be played and fizzle. The base face's declared target is required (R703): a Radiant Unit or face-up backrow card on either side or a Radiant card in your hand, never a face-down Trap. The Radiant face declares no target, so it takes the engine's new play gate (Script.play_allowed, play_choices::play_allowed), one check for legal_actions, the reducer's refusal ("<name> cannot be played without something to act on") and the view's playReason, read off the face the play resolves (R214); its gate asks for a Radiant card the opponent controls on the field that its player can see, so a face-down one does not open it (R440), though the Cry still clears it. A cast, an Echo repeat and a random cast never ask the gate (R70) and a set Spell's Reveal waits for it (R783006); a fusion holds every ingredient's gate and a copier its copied face's (R1851002). A Trade is no play, so Prestige is still Traded with nothing to clear. The script v0.4.9 ran is kept for replays (KEPT_SCRIPTS, R767000).

player.title: Prestige needs a card to De-Radiant
changes: Prestige can be played only with a card to De-Radiant: a Radiant card on the field or in your hand, or for its Radiant face a Radiant enemy card on the field.
A face-down card does not count, since you cannot see whether it is Radiant.
Prestige can still be Traded with nothing to De-Radiant, and a Prestige that is cast still resolves.
